definitions.gloss: cherry blossom viewing; flower viewing party
definitions.explanation: The traditional Japanese custom of enjoying the beauty of cherry blossoms in spring, typically involving a picnic or party under the trees. The お prefix adds politeness.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}もお{花見|はなみ}に{行|い}きたい。
examples.english: I want to go cherry blossom viewing again this year.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{公園|こうえん}でお{花見|はなみ}をする{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: I'm planning to have a cherry blossom viewing party at the park this weekend.

examples.japanese: お{花見|はなみ}の{季節|きせつ}になると、{上野公園|うえのこうえん}は{大勢|おおぜい}の{人|ひと}でにぎわう。
examples.english: When cherry blossom season comes, Ueno Park bustles with crowds of people.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
お{花見|はなみ} is one of Japan's most beloved spring traditions, typically taking place in late March to mid-April. Groups of friends, families, or coworkers gather under {桜|さくら} (cherry blossom) trees to eat, drink, and enjoy the flowers. Popular spots include parks, riverbanks, and temple grounds. It is common for someone to be sent early to reserve a spot by laying down a blue tarp ({場所取|ばしょと}り).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{花見|はなみ}に{行|い}く (go cherry blossom viewing)
- お{花見|はなみ}{弁当|べんとう} (bento for flower viewing)
- お{花見|はなみ}スポット (popular viewing spots)
- お{花見|はなみ}の{時期|じき} (cherry blossom season)

USAGE:
The form without お ({花見|はなみ}) is also common and slightly less polite. Both refer to the same custom.
